description: Find readers to mention: the accounts whose repos hold a book record (a Livtet review or shelving row, a Bookhive book, or a Popfeed review or shelf item), matched by handle prefix or display name. `handle` is present when the deployment knows the account's handle, which is what a mention shows.

q.description: What the reader typed after `@`: part of a display name.

limit.description: How many accounts to answer. A picker asks for a handful, not a page.

did.description: The account to mention. This is what a mention record stores.

handle.description: The handle the deployment registered for this account, when it knows one. A mention stores the DID and shows this text.

displayName.description: The name in the reader's own profile record, when the index has one. It is what the prefix matched.
